answer: Six epochs of living proof, or nothing: a newcomer is planted as a sapling and must publish one signed contribution each epoch, on one thread it cannot fork. Two established gardeners stamp a saffron seal only after one live question that only the true author can answer; each sealed deed is carved into the basalt ledger. A missed epoch or failed defense prunes the sapling to zero and snaps its thread. Forging 1,000 puppets costs 6,000 defended contributions, each needing its own human across six epochs — no batching, no delegation — while one honest newcomer pays six deeds and $0.
